messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscaler failed to grow pool 'gpu-pool-eu' after 4 attempts (scale_limit=4). queue_growth > 1000 reqs. paging oncall.

kai: Oncall kai here, looking. Which customers impacted?

maria: queue len ~1200, median token latency jumped 1.8s -> ~10s, 5xx and 429 rising. tenant-surge + eviction churn visible.

todd: seeing repeated node evictions and provider quota deny in the scale logs: 
```
scaleup attempt=4 result="denied" reason="provider_quota_exceeded" region=eu-west-1
```

maria: cloud API shows concurrent quota errors and spot interruptions spiking at 11:02 UTC. Not just one tenant.

raj: Support: customer-eta and enterprise customers A/B hit 503s in last 7m, opened tickets.

lisa: I've posted initial-facing status to affected customers and added note we're mitigating, will update in 15m.

kai: quick mitigation plan: 1) temporarily bump scale_limit to 8 for 30m (manual approval) 2) route heavy tenants to fallback-model-small 3) enable eviction-breaker runbook 4) throttle batch-size for big-models. Who can execute each?

todd: I can flip routing flag for fallback-model-small now (canary to 10% first). Pushing in 60s.

maria: I'll request quota bump with cloud support and start provisioning a warm spare pool in another AZ. Ticket CLD-7426 created.

ops-bot: Runbook snippet (eviction-breaker):
```
# enable temporary eviction-breaker flag
kubectl -n infra patch cm autoscaler-config -p '{"data":{"eviction_breaker":"true","eviction_breaker_ttl":"30m"}}'
# bump pool target (manual override)
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/gpu-pool-eu --replicas=8
```

kai: executing runbook now. tagging @todd @maria if rollback needed.

todd: routing flag pushed -> fallback-model-small at 10% for heavy tenants. Monitoring request/latency.

maria: manual scale to 6 succeeded but OOM eviction still happening on some nodes. logs show per-pod memory pressure from model-large batch_size=16.

todd: lowering batch_size to 8 for model-large on serving-config -> patching canary now.

raj: Customers reporting reduced 503s after fallback routing, some still seeing latency spikes.

lisa: sending customer update: "We applied temporary mitigations (fallback routing + autoscaler override). Monitoring and will provide a postmortem"

kai: we should also enable region-fallback routing to us-west as degrade mode for non-data-sensitive traffic. Can we do that safely?

todd: I can enable cross-region fallback for low-priority routes; will take 10m and a config flag.

maria: cloud support ETA is unclear. For long term, I propose adding a scale_denied alert so we don't hit this blind. Also need better model memory profiling pre-deploy.

ops-bot: CURRENT STATUS: mitigations applied: fallback routing (10%), batch_size reduced for model-large canary, manual pool scale partial. Queue length declining from 1200 -> 310 in 18m. No full customer outage reported after mitigations.

kai: good. immediate action items while hot:
- keep fallback routing until queue < 100 for 30m
- hold canary and monitor OOMs for 60m
- preserve logs and collect kernel OOM traces on evicted nodes

todd: logged the config change and will keep routing at 10% until PQ clears. Also will add a temporary autoscaler override toggle behind admin flag.

maria: post-incident followups:
- root cause: provider quota + model-large memory underestimation -> eviction feedback loop
- short-term fix: autoscaler emergency override, fallback routing, lower batch sizes
- medium-term: add scale_denied alert, increase provider quota, tighten eviction detection, model mem validation in CI
- owner for postmortem: maria (due 48h)

raj: support will consolidate customer impact timeline and attach ticket ids to postmortem.

lisa: will send 1hr and 4hr customer update templates and coordinate exec comms if needed.

kai: closing out hot loop: queue trending down, metrics look stable. I'll update incident channel in 30m and then mark as resolved if stable.

ops-bot: ACTION ITEMS (summary): ["Enable autoscaler emergency override (manual) - DONE (kai)", "Fallback routing for heavy tenants - DONE (todd)", "Lower batch_size canary - DONE (todd)", "Request cloud quota bump - OPEN (maria CLD-7426)", "Add scale_denied alert rule - OPEN (maria)", "Collect OOM traces + logs - OPEN (sre ops)", "Postmortem writeup - OPEN (maria)"]

kai: thanks team. filing a short postmortem and scheduling a follow-up in 24h to review permanent mitigations.

maria: adding note: consider making emergency autoscaler mode automatic when scale_denied rate > 3/min rather than manual.

todd: +1 on automated emergency path. Also will add a safeguard to avoid increasing batch_size under autoscaler pressure.

lisa: customer update posted. will ping again with any escalations.

kai: marking as monitoring. will ping 1715015600 with final state.

incident-bot: Incident marked MONITORING at 1715013200.

maria: final check at 1715015600: queue=42, median latency=2.1s, no new evictions in last 25m. Recommend resolve and track follow-ups.

kai: resolving from oncall. Postmortem owner maria. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
